title: Bye Bye Butterfree (the Pink Hierarchy)
lore: Single track, could eventually join a pink girl group, but for now she is by herself. A diva retelling of the iconic Bye Bye Butterfree episode from the early anime.

title: Heart Scales
lore: Gholdengo, driven by a pathological "Shiny Addiction," creates k-pop idols by cloning Dittos and permanently transforming them into high-fashion Pokémon using cursed Destiny Knots. These idols willingly trade their true identities for fame, having their traumatic memories wiped and replaced with glamorous, fabricated personas via "Heart Scales." As their psychological facade fractures and the "Just a Ditto" reality emerges, Gholdengo ruthlessly monetizes their breakdowns through "rebranding," ensuring the cycle of manufactured perfection continues.

title: Pixilate: The Fusions
lore: Used Suno's "mash-up" feature to essentially make battle songs for the two characters. Experimental release that allowed me to reuse resources with minimal effort. Spin off of the Banned Badge

title: Banned Badge
narrativeArc: The "Decaying High Fashion" era. Industrial horror vibes featuring the elite femme roster: Jynx, Gothitelle, Tsareena, Hatterene, and Gardevoir.

title: Region Locked
